Nottoway County, Virginia Tax Sales: Easy Guide to Buying Property at Auction

Nottoway County, Virginia holds tax sales when property owners fall behind on real estate taxes. These public auctions help the county recover funds and give buyers a chance to purchase real estate through a simple bidding process. If you’re considering jumping in, here’s a quick and clear guide.

Click Here to Get Dustin Hahn’s Tax Lien and Deed FREE Mini-Course

When Nottoway County Schedules Tax Sales

Tax sales aren’t held on a regular calendar. The county announces auctions only when qualifying properties become available.

  • Auction Frequency: As needed
  • Where to Check Dates: Visit the Auction Calendar or the Nottoway County Treasurer’s site

Time and Location of the Auction

Every auction notice includes the start time and venue.

  • Start Time: Listed in the auction announcement
  • Time Zone: Eastern Time (ET)
  • Location: Usually at or near a county government building
  • Tip: Always double-check the auction notice for the confirmed location

How to Register and Bid

You must register in advance to participate in the auction.

  • Is Registration Needed? Yes
  • When to Register:
    • Registration opens when the auction is announced
    • It closes shortly before the auction begins
  • How to Register: Follow steps in the official sale notice

Property Redemption Rules

Property owners can still stop the sale—but only up until auction day.

  • Before the Auction: They can pay all taxes and fees to redeem the property
  • After the Auction: Redemption is no longer allowed

Bidding and Payment Process

If you win a bid, make sure you understand the payment terms.

  • Bidding: Property goes to the highest bidder
  • Deposit: Usually due right after the auction ends
  • Final Payment: Must be completed using accepted methods listed in the auction terms
  • Accepted Payments: Refer to the notice—most accept certified funds, cashier’s checks, or money orders (no cash or personal checks)

Who to Contact for Tax Sale Info

If you need help or details, reach out to:

  • Nottoway County Treasurer’s Office
  • Email: treasurer@nottoway.org
  • Phone: (434) 645-9318

Where to Get Auction Updates

Stay informed by visiting:

  • Nottoway County Treasurer’s Website

Smart Tips for Tax Sale Success

Make sure you prepare ahead with these quick tips:

  • Confirm that utilities are fully connected; many auctioned properties still have functional services.
  • Set a firm spending limit—competitive bidding can escalate rapidly.
  • Reach out to the courthouse team before the auction if you have any questions.
